answer: Bind each agent to a tamper-evident card whose saffron dyed fiber pattern and crystal speckle are hashed into a public registry after one in-person government-ID and biometric check per person. A verifier requires a live scan and rejects duplicate hashes, so copying a pattern cannot forge a new identity. Extra identities need separate cards and separate applicants, each paying a renewal fee, so n sybils cost n fees and n humans. Profit is n(R-C) for a fixed per-identity reward, positive only while per-period reward exceeds that fee. Replayed scans and issuer collusion remain weaknesses.
